Market today: Tech is getting a boost from AI optimism, with a major consulting firm noting the revenue gap for AI buildouts. This is the main driver for your concentrated tech book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-36.69%) and SPAL (-36.58%) are flagged for attention. As leveraged ETFs, they decay and amplify drops, especially on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on TSMC, as a report suggests they're looking at a second U.S. chip-making site. This could be a catalyst.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for catalysts in key chip names.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL if they show further weakness; their leveraged nature is a major risk on margin.
Consider SMH if it breaks above its scanner entry of 599.41 with a stop at 597.52.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
